# Psalm 10 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 10:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** In-the-arrogance of-the-wicked he-hotly-pursues the-afflicted; let-them-be-caught in-the-schemes which they-have-devised.
- **LOGOS:** In arrogance the wicked hotly pursue the poor; let them be caught in the schemes they have devised.
- **PNEUMA:** The wicked arrogantly hunt down the poor. Let them be caught in the very traps they set.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
